snippet.title: Blur - Official Launch Trailer | HD
snippet.description:
A quote-packed trailer to celebrate Project Gotham Racing developer Bizarre Creations action racer zooming onto store shelves. Released in 2010, Blur is an adrenaline-pumping racing game that features up to 20 cars on a track, battling it out with dramatic crashes, hair-raising jumps, and power-ups to boost speed. It was available on PS3, Xbox 360, and PC.
